items.title: Does Fortive (FTV) Look Fairly Valued As AI Power Needs Grow?
items.summary: Fortive has delivered a solid run in recent years, and the question now is whether the cash flowing through the business is enough to support where the share price has ended up. With investors increasingly focused on what they are paying for a stream of future cash, the stock invites a closer look through a pure cash flow lens.
